status: LOCKED EXPLORATORY VALIDATION PROTOCOL, before model execution
authorization: Latest user task requests validation-only experiments A–C; no training, holdout model inference, data edits or external messages authorized. Cost/risks reported before GPU execution.
subset_rule: 200 lowest SHA256(275-ecsa-validation-v1|painting) among original validation rows; no class/prediction selection
precision: float32 encoder/head; pooled tokens rounded to float16 then restored as in saved cache; TF32 disabled
replacement: Gaussian blur, radius 12 encoder pixels mapped to decoded source scale
geometry: 7x7 equal display cells on 336 centre crop; mask projected back to decoded source; outside visible crop preserved. Adaptive pooled tokens overlap and do not equal independent image regions.
target: original predicted class of fixed R1 checkpoint; unchanged for every intervention
recompute: global image and pooled patches freshly encoded; all 28 whole-image attributes recomputed; changed deterministic description selects its matching pre-encoded frozen text embedding from all 27 possibilities
auc: raw fixed-target probabilities, trapezoid on observed fractions [5/49,24/49], divided by 19/49. No endpoints imputed; lower deletion/higher retention favourable.

bootstrap.unit: paired validation artwork; random trials averaged within artwork; conditional on selected checkpoint/subset

rise.upsampling: bilinear reflect, random shifts per original author implementation
rise.saliency: sum(target_probability * retained_mask)/(N*0.5), spatially averaged into matching 7x7 display cells
rise.label: RISE-style finite-mask comparator, exploratory; not claimed converged

resources.images: first 32 of same fixed hash-ranked validation subset
resources.timing: CUDA synchronized wall-clock, decode+features+head; load separately; image/text extraction reported separately from full pipeline
resources.RAM: peak process RSS sampled by psutil plus ru_maxrss; includes model load; shared libraries baseline disclosed
resources.VRAM: peak allocated/reserved CUDA bytes, reset after model load; model baseline also recorded

limits: development validation selected checkpoints, not independent test
